card.name: Inside the word idiopathic
card.fires_on: The piece "opathic" completing the word idiopathic, right after "idi". It appears in disease names such as idiopathic arthritis, urticaria, fibrosis and constipation.

modes.example: Juvenile idi<<opathic>> arthritis (JIA), sometimes called juvenile

modes.label: Idiopathic in lists
modes.description: The ending of idiopathic within lists of risk factors or contraindications.
modes.example: congenital or idi<<opathic>> methemoglobinemia, cardiac or pulmonary
